text:
harper: hey all, hi! landed my first PR to api-gateway. quick checklist Qs before i tidy it up: 1) branch naming preference? 2) commit message format? 3) i accidentally have compiled swagger JSON in my branch — do we keep those? 4) how many reviewers do i need?

nico: welcome Harper :wave: 1) branch: feat/<ticket>-shortdesc or fix/<ticket>-shortdesc. 2) commit: conventional-ish: type(scope): short summary (TICKET-123). one-line + optional body.

sam: for compiled swagger/json no — don't commit generated docs. remove from git and add to .gitignore. If CI needs generated docs we regenerate in CI.

marco: reviewers: at least one from CODEOWNERS for that path + one peer. If it's a risky change add an SRE reviewer. Small PRs = faster.

harper: thanks. i also have a bunch of tiny fixup commits from running format; should i squash?

nico: squash noisy commits before merge. interactive rebase is fine: git rebase -i origin/main and mark fixups. keeps PR tidy for reviewers.

pr-bot: pr-bot: FYI — remember to include a short "Testing" section in PR body and tag the ticket. PR templates will remind you but a quick checklist helps reviewers.

sam: extra: include a short steps-to-run locally and any env vars; if you change auth surface add a rollout note. Also run local lint/format: `make format && make lint` (or `yarn format && yarn lint` for JS).

harper: got it. what's our merge strategy? squash and merge?

marco: yes squash-and-merge default. if you really need to preserve commits note that in PR and ping me.

ci-bot: ci-bot: build #6120  queued

harper: one odd thing: CI failed once with a gofmt diff for a generated file. i regenerated and the diffs are only in generated code — how do i keep them out?

sam: regenerate locally, then reset generated files to upstream before committing. e.g. `git checkout origin/main -- path/to/generated/*` then stage only the source changes. force-push cleaned branch.

nico: last tiny tip: keep PR descriptions short: Summary, Why, "Testing", Checklist. If UI include screenshot. That speeds reviews.

harper: great, thanks everyone — i'll clean up the generated swagger, squash the fixups, add Testing section, and ping when CI is green :pray:
